verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMPISE,Mukama,
Okujjanga gy'oli,
Onnanze n'omusaayi gwo
Ogusinga byonna.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Nange ndi munafu;
Omubi-omwereere:
Ajja gye ndi simugoba
Bwe bwesige bwange.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Yesu,wanfiirira
Nze alina-ebibi
Okwagala kumpaludde,
Laba,nzize gy'oli.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Katonda Kitaffe,
Katonda Omwana,
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
Tweyanze bulijjo!
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi
